comment: Written against GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.94 (Homebrew cask copilot-cli; full-screen TUI on the alternate screen) from live sessions recorded in a pty in BYOK offline mode (COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL on an OpenAI-compatible LM Studio endpoint, no GitHub login); must be re-verified when Copilot CLI changes its TUI. Copilot redraws the whole screen, so an answered dialog does not linger and the approval rule may look at the whole screen. A permission or trust dialog ('Do you want to allow this access?', 'Do you trust the files in this folder?', options like '❯ 1. Yes' … 'No, and tell Copilot what to do differently (Esc to stop)', footer '↑/↓ to navigate · enter to select · esc to cancel') is BLOCKED; the status footer '◎ Working · … esc interrupt' (right after a prompt is sent: '○ Working esc edit prompt') is WORKING; the status footer 'Interactive · Manual Approval · …' without 'Working' is IDLE.

anyLineRegex: ↑/↓ to navigate · enter to select · esc to cancel
No, and tell Copilot what to do differently
